Usage: agentcage cage restore [OPTIONS] TARBALL

  Restore a cage from a backup tarball.

Options:
  --name TEXT  Restore with a different name (for cloning)
  --force      Overwrite existing cage
  --no-start   Restore without starting
  --no-color   Disable colored output.
  --quiet      Suppress progress output (spinners and banners).
  -h, --help   Show this message and exit.
